study.question: Does moving task separation into the nonlinear target/action history scorer improve the incumbent, and is partial sharing preferable to fully private or uniform sharing? Observations: task/action pooling g3-r0000-task_action_relevance has macro AUC 0.8114567736 versus shared/action 0.8111539425; the action input matters much more than task output routing. All four g3-r0001 group-routing cells regress in macro AUC despite purchase gains. All four g3-r0002 late-transfer cells remain below the incumbent, with peer_joint 0.8114146034 and peer_detached 0.8113338270. These successful executions with negative quality changes do not establish gradient conflict. No prior runtime error is reported.
study.hypothesis: The common nonlinear scorer basis may limit feedback-specific relevance even when its last output rows differ. Independently trainable task trunks can specialize before pooling; partial feature sharing may regularize scarce feedback tasks. Predict a macro-AUC gain for private or partial sharing over uniform sharing and the incumbent. Shared embeddings remain shared, so this tests scorer-level task coupling only, not complete gradient isolation.

nearest_work.difference: Archived exact-version primary text lines 52-88 describes target-conditioned local activation. Inherit that principle and the local multi-task/action adaptation; replace only sharing of its nonlinear scorer basis. This is not an exact original DIN reproduction or an originality claim.

Pinned lines 204-313 implement iterative multi-view hubs and gated broadcasts. Here fixed task mixing acts only on per-event nonlinear relevance states, without hubs, task masks, categorical tokens or iterative broadcasting.
Section 2.3 supplies external architecture descriptions, not local effects. Scorer sharing is a narrower intervention than the described whole-model token systems.

Resolved provenance and attempted primary read; detailed original text unavailable through registry. Original-paper equivalence and broader priority relative to shared-bottom, expert and task-specific networks remain unverified. No novelty claim.

inherited_components: Incumbent g3-r0000-task_action_relevance implementation, embedding tables, scorer widths and Dice activation
Four task-specific relevance output rows, historical action inputs/values, masks and unnormalized sum pooling
Four independent prediction towers, initialization order and default sum of four unweighted BCEs
Frozen offline visibility and category/brand auxiliary-label semantics; production timing validity remains unestablished
study.proposed_difference: After the incumbent reset and score-row equalization, retain one nonlinear scorer trunk and deepcopy it three times without RNG draws. For each event stack z_e from four trunks. Task t receives h_t=z_t+rho*(mean_e(z_e)-z_t), then its existing scalar output row and unchanged history pooling/tower. Submit rho=0 (private), 0.5 (partial) and 1 (uniform) plus byte-identical incumbent replay. rho=0 and 0.5 have full-rank mixing and equal nominal active capacity; rho=1 collapses to one functional basis under exact cloned initialization and is explicitly an effective-capacity/optimization control. No added learned gates, feedback groups, or late peer adapters.
predictions: Private or partial sharing exceeds uniform sharing and the incumbent on validation equal-weight four-task macro AUC. A private-versus-partial difference with matched parameters and event computation supports a sharing-dependent effect provisionally.

If partial sharing outperforms private especially on cart/fav/buy, this is consistent with useful regularization from cross-task sharing; if private dominates, it is consistent with a specialization benefit. Neither alone proves negative transfer or useful complementary information.

Initial logits, embedding/head parameters, Dice buffers and post-construction CPU RNG match the replay within declared floating-point tolerances; cloned trunks are equal but own distinct parameter/buffer storage. No equality after training is presumed.

Report every task AUC/Logloss and macro Logloss versus baseline-din and incumbent, parameter counts, training and inference time, and memory. Extra event-level nonlinear work is approximately four times the scorer trunk work, not a claimed whole-model speedup.

Use pre-existing empty/1-16/17-64/>64 history bins with the supplied sample/positive/negative counts. Empty-history results have only 45/28/13 cart/fav/buy positives and remain exploratory. No new slice eligibility threshold or per-task veto.
falsifiers: If neither private nor partial sharing improves macro AUC over replay, this implementation does not support replacing the incumbent, regardless of isolated purchase gains.
If private and partial cells are indistinguishable across repetitions, or uniform sharing matches them, task specialization is not a supported explanation.
If only uniform sharing beats the replay, replication-related optimizer scaling, clipping or numerical effects are more plausible than task-specific bases.
If initial predictions, data exposure, parameter ownership or information-boundary checks fail, the intended contrast is invalid until repaired; failed checks and retries remain charged.
alternative_explanations: Additional functional capacity, changed effective learning rates through mixing, AdamW normalization/epsilon and dense global clipping can explain differences. Same nominal parameters and FLOPs do not remove these confounds; no gradient-conflict measurement is available.

Uniform mixing plus cloned initialization preserves expert symmetry and reduces effective capacity; it is not an independent four-expert capacity control. rho=0 versus rho=0.5 is the primary full-rank sharing contrast.
Observed differences may be seed noise or adaptation to a one-pass recipe; prior rounds use one frozen seed and are not repeated mechanism support.
Inherited target query contributions at padded positions affect Dice statistics, even though masked IDs/actions are zeroed. This behavior is held fixed, not described as padding-free normalization.

Label prevalence is very unequal, auxiliary labels are category/brand matches, and offline feedback maturity is inherited. No conversion funnel or advertisement-specific purchase attribution is assumed.

held_fixed: Shared embeddings, item fields, action visibility, task heads, masks and unnormalized pooling
Same scratch seed, data order, one pass, batch 8192, optimizers, learning rates and loss
All three replicated cells allocate and execute four 64/32 Dice trunks and four scalar readouts
Initialize all trunks as exact copies of the incumbent trunk after its reset; preserve embedding/head weights and CPU RNG state
remaining_confounds: Mixing changes scorer gradient coupling, functional sharing and gradient magnitudes together; embedding gradients still mix all tasks.
Equal nominal capacity and initial function do not prove equal realized capacity or equal optimizer dynamics.
contrasts.decision_if_supported: Retain the better cell provisionally and reserve paired-seed follow-up; frame this as scorer-level sharing evidence, not proven negative-transfer removal.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: Do not assert benefit from fully private scorers; preserve null/negative outcomes and use macro selection.
